definitions.explanation: The branch of medicine dealing with the musculoskeletal system, including bones, joints, and muscles. In Japanese, this term refers specifically to orthopedics, not cosmetic surgery.

examples.japanese: {整形|せいけい}{外科|げか}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to the orthopedic clinic.

examples.japanese: {腰|こし}が{痛|いた}いので{整形|せいけい}{外科|げか}を{受診|じゅしん}した。
examples.english: I visited orthopedics because my lower back hurts.

examples.japanese: {骨折|こっせつ}の{疑|うたが}いがあるので、{整形|せいけい}{外科|げか}でレントゲンを{撮|と}ってもらった。
examples.english: Since there was a possibility of a fracture, I had an X-ray taken at orthopedics.

notes:
The medical specialty dealing with bones, joints, muscles, and the musculoskeletal system. In Japanese, {整形|せいけい}{外科|げか} refers specifically to orthopedics (bones and joints), not cosmetic surgery.

IMPORTANT DISTINCTION:
Do not confuse with {美容|びよう}{整形|せいけい} (cosmetic surgery). Despite both containing {整形|せいけい}, they are completely different fields. When Japanese people say they are going to {整形|せいけい}{外科|げか}, they mean the bone doctor, not a plastic surgeon.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {整形|せいけい}{外科|げか}を{受診|じゅしん}する: to visit an orthopedic clinic
- {整形|せいけい}{外科|げか}{医|い}: orthopedic surgeon
- {整形|せいけい}{外科|げか}{専門医|せんもんい}: orthopedic specialist

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {外科|げか} — surgery (general); the broader surgical field
- {接骨院|せっこついん} — bonesetter's clinic (traditional, non-surgical treatment)
- {美容|びよう}{整形|せいけい} — cosmetic surgery (different field entirely)
